correctness.rationale: The exact bijection from inverse-sum fibers to dyadic square-root congruences handles zero, valuation-one even roots, and higher-valuation odd roots. Square classes are counted for every modulus, including low modulus cases; summation gives both parity-dependent support formulas. The energy argument parametrizes all ordered quadruples and counts lifting factors exactly. A standalone integer checker exhaustively confirmed all 5,592,320 target cases for k=4..11; the independent proof, not the finite tests, establishes every k>=4.

originality.rationale: A complete pointwise valuation-dependent convolution law and the parity-dependent cardinality of its two-dimensional image were not implied by the specifically inspected primary results. Existing one-variable Kloosterman moment formulas cover or approach the energy corollary, which is not presented as independently novel; older coordinate-sum formulas concern a different map. The previous inverse-graph ring theorem treats only odd prime-power moduli. Historical priority is bounded, not asserted absolute.
residual_risks: A historical theorem on dyadic polynomial image densities or a broader inverse-graph sumset may imply the pointwise statement under another name; exhaustive priority is not established.
The fourth-moment energy corollary has substantial overlap with prior Kloosterman-moment methods and is not separately claimed original.

value.rationale: This gives the complete natural two-dimensional secant-addition image of the modular inverse hyperbola for infinitely many ramified residue rings. Exact per-target multiplicities and a parity-sensitive image law with limiting density 1/96 supply information unattainable from an energy or fourth-moment formula alone, and distinguish characteristic two from the published odd-prime-power problem. The claim does not rely on the novelty of quadratic-root calculations or a standalone moment value.
